meta_description: Majestic Painting & Decorating Southampton. Interior and exterior painting, full decoration services, and specialist finishes. Free quotes. Call now.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting that transforms your home. From single rooms to full renovations, we deliver pristine finishes on time.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decoration Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From interior refreshes to exterior transformations, we handle every aspect of professional painting and decorative work.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: We refresh living spaces with precision. Wall and ceiling painting, feature walls, and bespoke colour schemes bring new life to your rooms.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Protect and enhance your property's kerb appeal. We paint fascias, soffits, doors, and render walls with premium weatherproof finishes.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and trim work deserve expert care. We sand, prime, and finish all woodwork to a flawless standard.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, shops, and business premises benefit from our speedy, professional approach. We work around your schedule to minimise disruption.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Bespoke wallpaper hanging and textured finishes add character and depth. We source premium papers and execute flawless application.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Paint Effects
services.desc: Faux finishes, metallic effects, and bespoke colour matching create standout interiors. Perfect for period properties and design-led projects.

about_pullquote: We take pride in getting it right the first time, every time.
about_para_1: Majestic Painting & Decorating has been transforming Southampton homes and businesses for 18 years. Founded on the belief that great decoration is about attention to detail, we've built a reputation for reliability, clean workmanship, and fair pricing. Our team of experienced decorators carry all their own materials and tools, so we're ready to deliver from day one.
about_para_2: We've completed over 1,200 projects across Southampton and the surrounding areas, from Victorian terraces to modern apartments. Customers return to us because we listen, we don't rush, and we clean up properly at the end of every job. That's why more than eight out of ten of our work comes from referrals and repeat bookings.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Customers Say About Majestic

reviews.text: We'd been putting off decorating the lounge for ages. Majestic came round, listened to what we wanted, and gave us a fair quote. The work was done in three days, and the finish is brilliant. Mark and the lads were tidy, polite, and left the room spotless. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Paul T.

reviews.text: Needed the whole exterior painted before selling. Got three quotes, Majestic's was honest and their timescale was tight. They finished a week ahead of schedule and the buyers' surveyor commented on the quality of the work. Top team.
reviews.author: Sandra M.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare wallpaper job done elsewhere and called Majestic to fix it. They stripped it, made good the walls, and hung proper quality paper. No faffing about, no excuses, and the price was reasonable. Very impressed with the professionalism.
reviews.author: David L.
